purpose: Teach: 送別/追従/面識/外形/技巧/乗組/パネリスト/不買

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、卒業生の送別会を企画しろ
lines.en: Ren, organize the graduation send-off party.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Brief pause after the name. No room for negotiation, but not cold — expects competence and will get it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。流行への追従ではなく独自の研究を貫きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll maintain our own research direction rather than chasing trends.
lines.style: Quick affirmation. Earnest and slightly defensive. Speaks faster when committing to something — almost rushing to show understanding before he second-guesses himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、面識ある研究者を増やせ
lines.en: Ren, expand your network among researchers you know.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. The word 'expand' lands with weight. Practical instruction, not suggestion — this is how it works in the field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サンプルの外形特徴も記録します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also document the external characteristics of each sample.
lines.style: Slightly faster than the last affirmation. Showing he's already thinking ahead, already planning. Soft emphasis on 'also' — he's exceeding the bare instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Calm, final-sounding. Each word carries equal weight. This is foundational — not negotiable but not harsh, just true.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究船の乗組員として航海します
lines.en: Yes. I'll gain hands-on experience aboard the research vessel.
lines.style: Polite and formal, slightly more composed than before. He's moved past the initial nerves — this is now straightforward commitment. Ends on a note of quiet resolution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、シンポジウムのパネリストとして発言しろ
lines.en: Ren, present as a panelist at the symposium.
lines.style: Final instruction. Calm, assured — this is a deliberate step forward. Hiroshi believes in this. No performance, just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。誤った研究への不買、つまり批判的扱いも必要です
lines.en: Yes. And critical assessment of flawed research is essential — even if it means speaking against it.
lines.style: Earnest, more confident. He leans into the harder part of the sentence. Not hesitant — committed. Ends with quiet conviction, almost to himself.
